content.title: 2023 Guideline for the Diagnosis and Management of Atrial Fibrillation

content: Studies on the efficacy and outcomes of catheter ablation for atrial fibrillation.
Consideration of patient characteristics like age, left atrial size, and left ventricular function for treatment decisions.

sections.section_title: Technologies and Technologies for AF Catheter Ablation
content: Comparison of different ablation technologies, including radiofrequency and cryo-balloon ablation.
Analysis of economic evaluations, long-term success rates, and implications for future guidelines.
